questions.question: In Jesus' story about servants staying alert at night, who were the servants waiting for?
In Jesus' story of servants waiting up, what did the master do when he came home and found them on watch?

answers.text: He waited on them at the table
He gave each one a bag of silver
He let them sleep until morning

questions.question: Jesus said a faithful and wise manager found doing his job would be put in charge of all his master's possessions. True or false?
In Jesus' teaching about ready servants, what did He say about the person who has been given a great deal?

answers.text: Much will be required of them
Little will be required of them
Nothing will be required of them
